We had a good meal at Hoàng Sa Restaurant in Nha Trang. It’s a casual, local-style seafood restaurant with a simple, no-frills atmosphere, focusing on fresh ingredients rather than presentation. The menu offers a wide choice of seafood, prepared in a straightforward way that lets the natural flavours come through. Service was efficient and prices felt reasonable for the quality. A solid option for an authentic local seafood experience.

Disgusting.
Nov 2025 • Family
It's not just the dishes that are disgustingly cooked, the names don't match the menu.
They ordered pork ribs in sweet and sour sauce, caesar, rice with shrimp and spaghetti balognese (this is from food).
Now, ribs are present, but... Not as we used to, but the cuts are 2-3 cm without meat, just bones, full of onions in large slices and some other vegetables. I mean, there's no meat, and it was supposed to be, at least in name.
The second course is Caesar.
They brought a bunch of lettuce leaves, for some reason there were tomatoes and cucumbers around the edges, and instead of chicken, some bacon, and bits of unintelligible meat, a little dry, almost no sauce, and a crown on top, like a crown crown crown crowned one fried chicken egg (why didn't I get it fried)
Third course - rice with shrimp(asking for no spice) brought just a trough of spicy rice, with 5 shrimp on the shell that all the meat stuck to the shell) 
In the end, nobody ate much. 
The pasta didn't come. 
The smoothies that came with the whole order were paid separately for some reason.
.
I'll recap.
We're so unlucky, or maybe that's the way it is.
Prices do not match the quality of dishes. 
Each dish is like a copier 115-130k dong.
I do not recommend this restaurant
